Team — notes from the two reference conversations I completed today. I left Tara a voicemail; no response yet.

Attachments: kia_ref_notes_20260219.md (plain text, 6KB) — summary below and raw verbatim captured in the attached file.

Summary (TL;DR): Strong hire with one minor flag around cross-team escalation handling (documented but resolved). Both references recommended hireable.

Elena Park (15:30 PST, Zoom) — Highlights:
- Role fit: 4/5 — excellent at system design for scale and metrics processing
- Technical depth: 4/5 — solid ownership of key services and thoughtful trade-offs
- Ownership/drive: 5/5 — drove a multi-quarter migration with clear milestones
- Collaboration: 3/5 — can be blunt in cross-team discussions; improved after coaching
- Concerns: pushed back on org decisions previously; improved communication thereafter

Robert Cho (10:30 PST, phone) — Highlights:
- Role fit: 5/5 — ideal for senior infra role given on-call leadership and migrations
- Technical depth: 5/5 — led root cause analysis on a high-severity outage and owned remediation
- Ownership/drive: 4/5 — proactive and accountable
- Collaboration: 4/5 — constructive with peers; mentored junior engineers
- Concerns: none actionable; will note the escalation episode as a situational learning point

Recommendation: proceed to final onsite loop; suggest Laura spend ~20 minutes in onsite focusing on communication style + historical escalation context. If we move forward, I will attach the consent form and raw notes to the candidate record in Greenhouse and flag the one minor coaching item on the recruiter scorecard.
